events.did: 把红色皮卡开进汽车旅馆的停车场
events.quote_anchor: THE red pickup pulled into the motel lot well after midnight.

events.did: 把手放在 Syd 的肩上，轻轻把她摇醒
events.quote_anchor: He sighed and laid a hand on her shoulder.

events.did: 走进办公室向旅馆经理登记入住
events.quote_anchor: “Checking in,” said Mitch, unable to think of another reason he’d be standing there at 1 a.m.
“Two,” he said. “If you can put them side by side.”

events.did: 用现金付了房费，出门时从宣传车上的小册子里抽了一本
events.quote_anchor: He paid cash, and turned to go, but not before noticing the NO DOGS sign beside the door

events.did: 从外套口袋里摸出黑色药片，倒一片在掌心干吞下去
events.quote_anchor: He dug the pills from his coat pocket, tapped one into his palm and swallowed dry.

events.did: 把小册子递给 Syd，指着远处发亮的金属轮廓说那是老游乐园
events.quote_anchor: “Old amusement park,” he said, handing her the pamphlet he’d swiped from beside the door.

events.did: 带着 Dol 进入 12 号房间并关上门，Mitch 住进 13 号
events.quote_anchor: With that, she and Dol slipped into the room, and the door to number 12 swung shut.

relations.did: 让 Syd 留在车上别动，自己独自进办公室办入住
relations.quote_anchor: “Stay here,” he said, stepping out of the truck. “I’ll go check in.”

relations.did: 瞒着 Syd 服用来路不明的黑色药片，对她说那是治高血压的药
relations.quote_anchor: he’d made the mistake of saying they were for “hypertension,” hoping that would put the matter to rest

relations.did: 觉得 Mitch 身上的那种沉默专注越来越像 Victor，只是脸不像
relations.quote_anchor: More and more, she reminded him Victor. Not her face, but the thing behind it. That silent intensity.

relations.did: 和 Syd 约定在旅馆对老板隐瞒狗 Dol 的存在
relations.quote_anchor: Mitch cast a glance back over his shoulder at the motel lobby. “Do your best to keep the dog a secret.”

numbers.did: 办理入住时是凌晨 1 a.m.
numbers.quote_anchor: “Checking in,” said Mitch, unable to think of another reason he’d be standing there at 1 a.m.

numbers.did: 递给 Mitch 两把钥匙卡，房间号是 Twelve 和 thirteen，在二楼
numbers.quote_anchor: “Twelve and thirteen. That’s on the second floor, so you have a better view.”

numbers.did: 整家旅馆只有 two floors、每层 eight rooms on each、sixteen doors 都朝向同一片停车场
numbers.quote_anchor: there were only two floors, eight rooms on each, sixteen doors all facing the same lot.

numbers.did: 手表每 six-hour 响一次，提示他该吃下一片药
numbers.quote_anchor: As he trudged back out into the lot, his watch chimed its six-hour warning.

numbers.did: 说 Bethany 的商场 ten years back 就关了，主题公园 shuttered last year
numbers.quote_anchor: the mall closed ten years back, and the theme park shuttered last year

numbers.did: 停车场里只有 only two other cars，其中一辆看起来几周没动过
numbers.quote_anchor: He’d picked the motel for its nondescript appearance, its free Wi-Fi, and the fact there were only two other cars in the lot
